blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The claims of a dismissed cop Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. against Vice President Duterte and her other family members may reach the Office of the Ombudsman, its chief Jesus Crispin Remulla said on Monday. Last week, Gracioso surfaced and claimed that he allegedly delivered suitcases of cash to Vice President Sara Duterte, former President Rodrigo Duterte, and Davao City Rep. Paolo Duterte. Gracioso, who claimed to be a former security aide of former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco, said the deliveries were done upon alleged instruction of the said ex-Marinduque lawmaker.
